Sales_taxes_19_percent: The value-added tax rate is 19% for most taxable turnovers.
Sales_taxes_7_percent:
There is a reduction to 7% for certain turnovers, including:

Deliveries, imports, and intra-community acquisitions of specific items.
Rental of specific items.
Breeding and keeping of livestock, cultivation of plants, and performance testing for animals.
Services related to animal breeding and dairy farming.
Services provided by dental technicians and specific services by dentists.
Admission to theaters, concerts, museums, and similar performances.
Provision of films, circus performances, and services related to zoological gardens.
Services by nonprofit corporations and certain associations and communities.
Turnovers related to the operation of swimming pools and the administration of medicinal baths.
Transportation of persons using various modes of transport.
Rental of living and sleeping quarters, as well as short-term rental of camping spaces.
Import of specific items.
Deliveries and intra-community acquisitions of specific items.
Provision of certain products in electronic form.
Restaurant and catering services, excluding beverages, after June 30, 2020, and before January 1, 2024.
Sales_taxes_0_percent: There is a 0% reduction for the delivery of solar modules in connection with photovoltaic systems as well as their intra-community acquisition, import, and installation.
